identity.name: RetroVMS Mini
identity.description: Vehicle control module with 24 inputs, 12 outputs, and CAN bus

status_led.description: Onboard RGB status LED - GRB order

buzzer.description: Magnetic buzzer on a transistor. It needs a tone, so PWM the pin at frequency_hz with 50% duty, then drive it low: held high, DC runs through the coil. A MicroMod processor in the socket shares this line on G2

mcp2515_can1.description: CAN1 controller, whose RX0BF and RX1BF pins switch CAN0 and CAN1 termination

rtc.description: Real-time clock holding UTC, kept going by two 47 uF capacitors while the board is off. The firmware sets the system clock from it at boot and sets it whenever NTP syncs, so time.time() already uses it. lib.sys.drivers.rx8111 reads and writes it directly

micromod.description: Takes an STM32F405 module, whose ROM bootloader is a UART on these pins, shared with I2C. Install the micromod app to program it

wwan.description: Cellular modem socket on USB, off until power_pin is high
